name: TaxJar
summary: TaxJar covers US sales tax with real-time calculation through an API, an economic nexus tracker, state registration services and AutoFile for returns. Starter costs $39 a month and Professional costs $99 a month, both for 200 orders a month, with filing sold as yearly credits.

facts.text: Starter includes 2 AutoFile credits a year and Professional includes 4, with extra credits costing $50 and $55.
API access is not available on Starter. Professional lists 10,000 API calls a minute and a developer sandbox.
Annual billing saves 10% or more, and flex fees let an account move temporarily to a higher order tier for busy months.
TaxJar's pricing page recommends Stripe Tax to Stripe customers, and Stripe lists TaxJar as a filing partner for Tax Complete.
TaxJar states a 100% on-time filing rate for AutoFile in 2025.

plans.name: Starter
plans.unit: per account, up to 200 orders a month
plans.notes: 2 AutoFile credits a year, up to 3 data import integrations, no API
